wiki.title: Daisy Hartsfield
wiki.extract: Daisy Lynn Balais Hartsfield is an American social worker, attorney, and politician serving as a member of the Hawaii House of Representatives for the 36th district since 2026. A member of the Democratic Party, Hartsfield was appointed to the role by Governor Josh Green to succeed then-Representative Rachele Lamosao, who was appointed to the Hawaii State Senate earlier that year.
